## OAuth clients for import-verify-clien: ## name: application display name. role: mint
## audiences/claims: pipe-separated resource names and token claim names.
## The mint and exchange clients need separate ids and application entitlement.
## The agent uses a JWT client-credentials token with no user roles or teams.
## Its exchange client needs birthright entitlement because the agent has no SCIM
## user id. The importer also creates an Agent Registry record and writes its id
## as VERIFY_AGENT_ID. Registry status is enforced by the gateway.
